items.text: Space adventurers,
We have continuously worked on improving your experience with Rivage and are now ready with a new patch. It includes:
the glitch effect on the Arcade machine is removed, if the player has already looped previously
once the Arcade machine has been used at least once, a Loop option appears in the menu for easier and faster looping
the Cubik's Cube now has a fixed start position
Datalens.exe cannot be executed anymore on a computer that doesn't have the file
the Morse Code volume is now linked to the Global volume
a fix for Linux and Steam Deck crashing (even though please note that we don't officially support them)
if the player loses in the Arcade machine game, the boss will not continue firing, rather it is destroyed
players cannot crouch and run at the same time anymore
assembly machine in the Garage plays the activated sound when approached even when the power is off
accessibility icons no longer mismatch between Rafael's drawing and the safe in the Garage
some minor texture overlapping in the Lobby and Garage has been fixed
anti-aliasing mode "Nvidia DLSS Ray Reconstruction" now fits the text block
setting reflections on Low in the Settings now shows ingredients on the table clearly
subtitles no longer cover part of the UI when the player takes an item for the first time
it's no longer possible to break and lose the Loop cursor on the Arcade machine after losing the boss battle
multi-monitor switching now works properly
"Already downloaded" prompt persists on the UV light after re-collecting the Multi-pass card
walking backwards through the portal slowly no longer gets the player behind the portal
when turning off the accessibility mode, part of the icons no longer remain visible

As usual, we continue looking into your feedback and improving the game. If you encounter any issues, please let us know at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 This is the fastest way for us to work with your question directly.
The Exnilo and Raw Fury Team

items.text: Dear space adventurers,

Since the release of Patch 1.1.6 last week and as per our commitment to make Rivage the best game it can be, we have been channeling our inner Miranda to find the best solutions for the issues you have reported. Thank you for your trust and patience.

For this patch, we've been cooking up further improvements to make Rivage look and feel the way we've always envisioned it to be. Our two-people dev time worked closely with the tech experts over at Fury Studios and together we managed to further optimize and improve the performance and visuals of Rivage. We've worked hard to give you more options to customize the settings, so that you could get the best experience possible. Please find the changelog below:
We fixed the root causes of several crash issues, especially Intel CPU laptops with NVIDIA GPUs.
We bring you major performance fixes and further optimization as we have achieved 15% to 35% improvements at certain points.

There are now latest vendor-specific tech solutions for visuals: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 and AMD FSR Redstone (FSR 4) as anti-aliasing modes with DLSS Ray Reconstruction for the fastest devices and Intel XeSS for integrated GPUs. These options combined with cutting edge Frame Generation should make the game run smoothly and look beautiful even on lower settings.
Low and Medium quality setups are now gorgeously looking, only slightly toned down from the Cinematic experience.
Fixed community reported grain and blur issues with modern device-specific solutions.
Added more rendering resolution options.

Added colorblind options: affected puzzles are the TV riddle in the Miranda's Room, the Lobby showcase puzzle, xylophone puzzle (both the drawing in Rafael's room and the instrument in the Lobby), Cubik's Cube vault, Rafael's drawing after completing the hexadecimal puzzle on the first floor of the Lobby, Cubik's Cube scheme on the first floor of the Lab.
Fixed the Horizon Probe's tarot card animation after the players move too far away.
Morse code volume has been increased.
Players can now scan and add the Tarot cards to their K9 interface.
Fixed descriptions of the Tarot cards.
Ares Station video in the Observatory will stop playing, if the players open the shutters.
Reworked the Cubik's Cube puzzle – players no longer need to stand in a specific spot to solve it and teleport to Rafael's hiding space.
Reworked the Laboratory fingerprint puzzle – players can now only scan items with the Jonny Kim's fingerprint. Other items will no longer display a scanable fingerprint.
Added extra clues for the vault in the Laboratory – blood trail near the vault now informs the player to search for other blood spots in the Lab.
Removed a lighting issue near the vending machine in the Observatory,
Added correct new art that shows the in-game version of the Jahi's train part.

We remain hard at work to further improve and fix any issues you might encounter. As before, if you have an issue with the game, please report it at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 That way we can investigate your files directly.
Enjoy your adventure aboard A.R.E.S.!
The Exnilo and Raw Fury Team
Hello space adventurers.
Thank you for reaching out to us via the support desk - as before, we're actively at work to resolve the issues/questions you submit. In this patch we have solved the following:
Gameplay
Collision in the garage on the first floor is fixed and you can no longer see through it.
Added a confirmation which appears when you press the quit button in the menu.
Fixed the issue where the snacks in the vending machine were clipping into each other.
Various monitors in the reactor area will now shut down when the power runs out.
Fixed the blood being visible next to the pipe in the lab.
Some cables on the first floor of the garage are now positioned correctly.
A.R.E.S. presentation will no longer freeze when pausing the game.
Coins in the arcade game no longer make a sound as if they were collected when they disappear from the screen.
3D printer panels in the garage no longer overlap after the power loss.
Fixed Miranda's voice line that says an item is missing after inserting the data disk in the card reader on the first floor of the Lobby.
The computer on the ground floor of the garage will now be shut down after the player triggers the blackout and returns to the garage by train.
Display in Rafael's locker in the Pod Bay area will be powered off after triggering the blackout.
Repositioning an object while in the inspection mode will no longer change the audio direction of Miranda's footsteps.
Players can no longer move early after opening the shutter in the Observatory.
Fixed minor inconsistencies in Miranda's diary.
Players can no longer place/take out an ID card from the Access Card builder from very far away.
Updated the name of the file on the laptop in the Observatory to match the opened document.
Localization
New Japanese localization added.
Fixed grammar in Miranda's journal.
Fixed grammar in French for “to loop” and “loop”.
Completed and polished all localized languages more.
Credits
Fixed missing Credits.
Fixed an issue with Spanish localization being Russian.
Added the Engine Disclaimer in the Credits.

If you encounter an issue with the game, please let us know at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 so that we could have a look as soon as possible. As per our commitment to deliver the Rivage experience at the best quality it can be, we continue actively working on your reports and improving the experience.
Have a great time exploring the A.R.E.S. space station!

Hello everyone, thank you for bearing with us as we have been investigating the issues you have reported after the release yesterday. Once again, we're sorry you have encountered them at the first place, and like we said in our previous posts, - we've been as unhappy about this as you, and hard at work to find fixes with our 2-people dev team.
1. Fixed 4k + Windows upscaling

Windows display scaling could accidentally make Unreal think your monitor was smaller than it really was. As a result, the game would sometimes render at a lower resolution and then stretch that image to fill the screen which could make the game look blurry.
2. Fixed the render resolution not changing from 59%
A bug in the options menu allowed users to change render resolution while upscale was enabled but this shouldn't have been possible and it resulted in no visible difference.
3. Fixed a mouse input bug in the color matching puzzle
It was sometimes not possible to interact with the left slot of the color matching puzzle.
4. Blurriness issue
The project uses cutting edge Unreal Engine technologies which did not adapt correctly to non-4K resolutions. We're still working on the issue but have applied a potential fix for the affected users.

We continue monitoring your feedback, so if you have further issues with the game, please let us know at https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1 That way we can investigate your case as soon as possible. We're committed to continue improving the game.

We sincerely hope that with this patch your Rivage experience will be closer to what we have envisioned it to be on the release. Once again, we apologize for any inconvenience caused and we hope you will enjoy Rivage!
✨Space travelers,✨
